entry_item.definition: v.i. To harden, dry; to freeze, freeze over; to be blocked, entangled, caught, or jammed; to become mulish, obstinate; to resist, thwart, oppose; to contradict; to interfere, stand in the way; to die ( of animals).

example.definition: To be or stand in somebody's way.
